description: Answers "How is my TSLA position doing?" and "How much TSLA exposure do I have?" for a stock symbol or an options underlying: value, unrealized P&L, shares and average cost, exposure in share-equivalents (option delta only when the broker reports it), and a payoff chart at expiration for option positions. Read-only. Shows an interactive panel in apps that support MCP Apps; always returns a text summary and a botspot.trade link.
name: show_position
title: Show one position
